name: petko
author: G-Lab
description: Петко — српска ћирилична игра речи. Capacitor paketi za Google Play i App Store, Electron za Windows, PWA za Mac.

scripts.cap:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync
scripts.cap:sync:android: npm run build && npx cap sync android
scripts.cap:sync:ios: npm run build && npx cap sync ios
scripts.android: npm run cap:sync:android && npx cap open android
scripts.ios: npm run cap:sync:ios && npx cap open ios
scripts.android:debug: npm run cap:sync:android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.android:bundle: npm run cap:sync:android && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
scripts.win:dir: npm run build && npm run win:ico && node scripts/win-sign-env.js --win dir --x64 -p never
scripts.win:build: npm run build && npm run win:ico && node scripts/win-sign-env.js --win nsis --x64 -p never
scripts.win:appx: npm run build && npm run win:ico && node scripts/make-appx-assets.js && node scripts/win-sign-env.js --win dir --x64 -p never && node scripts/pack-appx-wine.js && node scripts/stage-release.js
